scenario: 面试官让你解释 feature store 到底在 ML 系统里承担什么角色、解决什么问题。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what role a feature store plays in an ML system and what it solves.
q: feature store 的核心定位是什么？
q_en: What is a feature store at its core?
why: 它是让批、流、请求时三类管线汇聚的中心化特征层，给训练和推理同一套取数接口。存在的理由是解决三件事：point-in-time 正确性、训练-服务偏差、特征复用。
why_en: It is the centralized feature layer where batch, streaming, and request-time pipelines converge and serves one interface to both training and inference, solving point-in-time correctness, training-serving skew, and feature reuse.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  B["批处理管线"] --> FS[("feature store")]
  ST["流式管线"] --> FS
  RT["请求时管线"] --> FS
  FS --> TR["训练 offline"]
  FS --> IN["推理 online"]
options: 训练框架：定义网络结构、跑梯度下降与反向传播，数据存储与线上服务不归它管
更快的在线 KV 缓存：唯一职责是把线上特征读延迟压到 10ms 内，不碰训练侧
批/流/请求时管线汇聚的中心特征层，给训练和推理供统一取数，管 point-in-time 正确性、训练-服务偏差、特征复用
特征分布可视化面板：供数据科学家浏览统计，不参与线上取数，也不参与训练供数
options_en: A training framework: it defines the network and runs gradient descent; storage and serving are out of scope.
Just a faster online KV cache whose only job is sub-10ms feature reads; it never touches the training side.

The centralized feature layer where batch/streaming/request-time pipelines converge, serving both training and inference, and owning point-in-time correctness, training-serving skew, and feature reuse.
A feature-distribution dashboard for data scientists to browse stats; it serves neither online reads nor training data.
optionExplanations: 训练框架管的是模型怎么算，feature store 管的是特征怎么定义、存、取；两者是不同层。
在线低延迟读只是它的一半（online store），它还要管训练侧的离线取数和一致性，缓存说法太窄。
对；它的价值就在「同一份特征定义同时喂训练和线上」，三大问题都由此派生。
可视化只是 registry 的附带能力；把它当纯看板，就丢掉了训练/推理供数这个主职责。
optionExplanations_en: A training framework governs how the model computes; a feature store governs how features are defined, stored, and served — different layers.
Low-latency online reads are only half of it (the online store); it also owns offline training reads and cross-path consistency, so 'cache' is too narrow.
Correct — its value is 'one feature definition feeds both training and serving,' from which all three problems derive.
Dashboarding is a side capability of the registry; treating it as a viewer drops the core job of serving training and inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 中心化特征基础设施：统一定义、存储、供给特征给训练与推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature store is centralized feature infrastructure that defines, stores, and serves features to both training and inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练样本只用「标签事件发生那一刻已知」的特征值，不泄漏未来数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Point-in-time correctness means a training example only uses feature values known at the moment the label event occurred, leaking no future data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按键取值的存储（Redis/DynamoDB），线上毫秒级读特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A key-value store (Redis/DynamoDB) fetches values by key and serves online features in milliseconds.

q: 补全 feature store 要解决的三大问题：
q_en: Fill in the three problems a feature store solves.
text: Feature store 解决三大问题：训练时只用标签时刻已知值的 {{point-in-time}} 正确性；离线训练与线上服务用同一份定义、避免 training-serving {{skew}}；一份特征定义被多团队 {{reuse}}（复用）。
text_en: A feature store solves three problems: {{point-in-time}} correctness, training-serving {{skew}}, and cross-team feature {{reuse}}.
why: 这三件是面试官期待你张口就点名的：正确性防未来泄漏、偏差防离线/线上代码分叉、复用防多团队各造一份。
why_en: These three are what interviewers expect you to name: correctness prevents future leakage, skew prevents offline/online code divergence, and reuse prevents each team rebuilding its own version.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练与线上服务用不同代码路径算同一特征，微小差异悄悄拖垮模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is when training and serving compute the same feature via different code paths, silently degrading the model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多个团队/模型共享同一份规范化的特征定义，而非各造略有差异的版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feature reuse means multiple teams/models share one canonical feature definition instead of building slightly different copies.

scenario: 信用违约模型有个「近 30 天交易笔数」特征。用 user_id 直接 join 会把「今天」的计数（含申请之后甚至违约本身产生的交易）也算进训练样本。
scenario_en: A credit-default model has a '30-day transaction count' feature. Joining on user_id alone grabs today's count, including transactions after the application (even the default itself).
q: 怎么保证训练样本不泄漏未来数据？
q_en: How do you keep future data out of the training example?
why: 必须做 point-in-time join：按事件时间戳，只取「标签事件发生那一刻之前」的特征值。裸 user_id join 忽略时间轴，会把标签之后的交易泄漏进特征，offline AUC 虚高、上线崩盘。
why_en: Do a point-in-time join keyed on event timestamps, taking only feature values known before the label event, because a plain user_id join ignores time and leaks post-label transactions.
tradeoff: point-in-time join（正确但要维护事件时间戳） vs 裸 join（简单但泄漏未来）
options: 按事件时间戳做 point-in-time join，只取标签事件之前已知的特征值
直接用 user_id join，取当前最新的 30 天计数，简单且线上线下一致
把 30 天窗口放大到 90 天，多取历史数据来稀释未来交易的影响
在训练前对计数做标准化，让含未来数据的样本分布和纯历史样本对齐
options_en: Do a point-in-time join on event timestamps, taking only feature values known before the label event.
Just join on user_id and take the current latest 30-day count — simple and consistent online/offline.
Widen the 30-day window to 90 days so more history dilutes the impact of future transactions.
Standardize the count before training so samples with future data align in distribution with pure-history samples.
whenOtherWins: 如果特征是完全静态、从不随时间变化（如注册国家），没有未来值可泄漏，裸 join 才安全。
whenOtherWins_en: A plain join is safe only when the feature is fully static and never changes over time (e.g. country of registration), so there is no future value to leak.
optionExplanations: 对；只有按事件时间戳截取「标签之前」的值，才能保证训练看到的和线上预测那一刻看到的一致。
裸 join 取的是「今天」的计数，把申请后的交易甚至违约本身喂进特征——这正是泄漏源头。
放大窗口不改时间轴问题：90 天窗仍会把标签后的交易算进去，泄漏照旧。
标准化只动数值刻度，不改「用了未来信息」这个事实，泄漏无法靠归一化消掉。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — only cutting values at the event timestamp 'before the label' matches what the model sees at prediction time in production.
A plain join takes today's count, feeding post-application transactions and even the default itself into the feature — the leak source.
Widening the window does not fix the time axis: a 90-day window still counts post-label transactions, so the leak persists.
Standardizing only rescales values; it does not undo the fact that future information was used, so normalization cannot remove the leak.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按事件时间戳把特征截到标签发生时刻之前的连接方式，防未来泄漏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A point-in-time join keys on event timestamps to take feature values only up to the label event, preventing future leakage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量二分类排序能力的指标，0.5=随机、1=完美。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) measures a binary classifier's ranking ability, 0.5 being random and 1 perfect.

scenario: 训练时用裸 user_id join（忽略时间戳）算特征，offline AUC 高得离谱，上线后掉到接近随机。
scenario_en: Training joins on user_id alone (ignoring timestamps); offline AUC is unrealistically high, then collapses to near-random in production.
q: 这个「离线高、线上崩」是什么在作祟？
q_en: What causes 'great offline, collapses online' here?
why: 未来数据泄漏：训练特征里混进了标签之后才知道的信息，模型在「作弊」，所以 offline 虚高；线上预测那一刻拿不到未来值，能力立刻现原形。
why_en: Future-data leakage: training features contain information known only after the label, so offline is inflated, but at prediction time the future values are unavailable and performance collapses.
options: 线上流量分布突变（真实 data drift），需要重新训练模型适配新分布
未来数据泄漏：训练特征混进了标签之后的信息，线上拿不到这些未来值就崩
线上机器算力不足，推理被降级，导致精度下降到接近随机
特征归一化参数没同步到线上，只是简单的配置漂移问题
options_en: A sudden shift in live traffic distribution (real data drift) requiring retraining to the new distribution.
Future-data leakage: training features carry post-label information the model cannot access online, so it collapses.
Insufficient online compute downgrades inference, dropping accuracy to near-random.
Normalization parameters were not synced to serving — just a simple config drift.
optionExplanations: drift 会让线上分布和训练不同，但这里问题从训练那一刻就埋下了——特征本身用了未来信息，不是分布变了。
对；泄漏让模型在离线「预知未来」，线上没有未来值，落差就是这么来的。
算力不足会加延迟或超时，不会把一个学到真信号的模型精度打回随机；症状对不上。
归一化不同步是小幅偏差，解释不了从 95% 掉到接近随机的断崖，量级不符。
optionExplanations_en: Drift makes live distribution differ from training, but here the problem is baked in at training time — the feature itself used future info, not a distribution change.
Correct — leakage lets the model 'see the future' offline; online there is no future value, hence the gap.
Insufficient compute adds latency or timeouts; it would not knock a model that learned real signal back to random — symptoms don't match.
Normalization mismatch is a small bias; it cannot explain a cliff from 95% to near-random — wrong magnitude.

termDefinitions.term: future-data leakage / 未来数据泄漏
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练特征里混进了预测时刻还不可知的信息，导致 offline 虚高、线上崩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Future-data leakage is when training features include information unknown at prediction time, inflating offline metrics and collapsing online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上输入分布随时间偏离训练分布，是与泄漏不同的另一类退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data drift is when the live input distribution shifts away from training over time — a different failure than leakage.

scenario: 有些事件（如手机离线后补传的日志）到达数据管线的时间，比它实际发生的时间晚几小时。训练和线上如果一个用发生时间、一个用到达时间，会产生难查的偏差。
scenario_en: Some events (e.g. logs uploaded after a phone was offline) arrive hours after they actually happened. If training uses one clock and serving another, a hard-to-diagnose skew appears.
q: 计算带时间窗的特征时，该用哪种时间戳？
q_en: Which timestamp should time-windowed features use?
why: 统一用 event time（事件真正发生的时刻），不用 processing time（数据到达/被处理的时刻）。晚到事件让两种时钟错位，训练和线上各用一种就会算出「看着都合理却对不上」的特征，偏差极难定位。
why_en: Always use event time (when it actually happened), not processing time (when it arrived), because late events desynchronize the two clocks and mixing them across training and serving yields plausible-looking but mismatched features.
tradeoff: event time（正确但要等晚到事件、可能补算） vs processing time（简单但晚到事件造成 skew）
options: processing time：以数据到达管线的时刻为准，实现最简单，反正差几小时无所谓
训练用 event time、线上用 processing time，各取所需，两边分别调到最优
event time：以事件真正发生的时刻为准，训练与线上都用它，才能对齐晚到事件
用两者的平均时间戳做折中，既照顾发生时刻又照顾到达时刻
options_en: Processing time: use when data arrived at the pipeline — simplest to implement; a few hours' gap doesn't matter.
Event time for training, processing time for serving — pick what's convenient and tune each side separately.
Event time: use when the event actually happened, on both training and serving, so late-arriving events line up.
Use the average of the two timestamps as a compromise between happen-time and arrive-time.
whenOtherWins: 若管线保证事件近乎实时到达、几乎无晚到（如同机房内部埋点），event/processing 差异可忽略，processing time 更省事。
whenOtherWins_en: Processing time is fine when the pipeline guarantees near-real-time arrival with negligible lateness (e.g. same-datacenter telemetry), so the two clocks barely differ.
optionExplanations: 「差几小时无所谓」正是错处：晚到事件会让某天的窗口计数训练和线上算不一样，这就是 skew。
两边用不同时钟是最典型的 skew 制造机——特征值两边都看着合理却系统性对不上。
对；event time 是事件的「真时刻」，两边都锚在它上，晚到日志补进正确的窗口，训练与线上才一致。
平均时间戳没有物理含义，既不是发生时刻也不是可复现的到达时刻，只会制造新的不一致。
optionExplanations_en: 'A few hours don't matter' is exactly the trap: late events make a day's window count differ between training and serving — that is skew.
Different clocks on each side is the classic skew generator — values look plausible on both but systematically disagree.
Correct — event time is the true moment; anchoring both sides to it lets late logs fall into the right window, keeping training and serving aligned.
An averaged timestamp has no physical meaning — neither the happen-time nor a reproducible arrive-time — so it only creates new inconsistency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 事件真正发生的时刻，是带时间窗特征的正确基准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Event time is when an event actually occurred — the correct basis for time-windowed features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据被管线接收/处理的时刻，受晚到影响，会与 event time 错位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Processing time is when the pipeline received/processed data; it drifts from event time under late arrivals.

scenario: 同一个特征，离线训练用 Spark UDF 算，线上服务用一段 Python 函数算。模型上线后精度悄悄比离线差，但没有报错。
scenario_en: The same feature is computed by a Spark UDF offline and a Python function online. After deploy, accuracy is quietly worse than offline, with no errors.
q: training-serving skew 的根因是什么？
q_en: What is the root cause of training-serving skew?
why: 同一特征走两条不同代码路径（离线一套、线上一套），浮点精度、null 处理、窗口边界的微小差异让两边算出的值系统性不同，模型悄悄退化。根因是「两份实现」，不是数据本身变了。
why_en: The same feature runs through two different code paths, and tiny diffs in float precision, null handling, or window boundaries make the values systematically differ, silently degrading the model.
options: 线上用户行为真的变了，是真实的 concept drift，需要重训模型
同一特征离线/线上各写一套代码，浮点、null、窗口边界的微小差异让两边值系统性不同
线上模型版本比离线旧了一两个迭代，权重没同步导致精度差
在线特征存储的读延迟太高，来不及取全特征就返回，导致部分特征缺失
options_en: Live user behavior genuinely changed — real concept drift — so retrain the model.
The same feature has two implementations offline vs online; tiny float/null/window-boundary diffs make the values systematically differ.
The online model is a version or two behind offline; unsynced weights cause the accuracy gap.
The online store's read latency is too high, so it returns before fetching all features, causing missing values.
optionExplanations: drift 是数据分布变了；skew 是「同样的数据两套代码算出不同值」，两回事，这里源头在实现分叉。
对；关键词是「双代码路径」——离线 Spark UDF 与线上 Python 函数的实现差异制造了系统性偏差。
版本落后是部署问题，会整体拉低精度但不是 skew；skew 特指特征计算路径的分叉。
读延迟高会缺特征或超时，属于服务可用性问题，不是同一特征算出两个值的 skew。
optionExplanations_en: Drift is a distribution change; skew is 'the same data computed to different values by two code paths' — different, and here the cause is implementation divergence.
Correct — the keyword is 'dual code path': the offline Spark UDF vs online Python function differ in implementation, creating systematic bias.
A stale version is a deployment issue that lowers accuracy overall but is not skew; skew is specifically divergent feature computation.
High read latency causes missing features or timeouts — an availability issue — not the same feature computing two values.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 Spark 批处理里自定义的特征计算函数，常用于离线管线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Spark UDF (User-Defined Function) is a custom feature-computation function in Spark batch, common in offline pipelines.

termDefinitions.meaning: 输入到标签的真实关系随时间改变，与代码分叉造成的 skew 不同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Concept drift is when the real input-to-label relationship changes over time, distinct from code-divergence skew.

scenario: 团队反复被 training-serving skew 咬到：每次有人改了离线特征逻辑，线上那份忘了同步，模型就悄悄退化。
scenario_en: A team keeps getting bitten by training-serving skew: someone changes the offline feature logic and forgets to sync the online copy, quietly degrading the model.
q: 从架构上根治 skew 最直接的做法是？
q_en: What most directly fixes skew at the architecture level?
why: 让离线物化和线上服务共用同一份特征定义（一份代码/规范同时驱动两边），从根上消掉双代码路径。这正是 Tecton 这类带统一 transformation engine 的 feature store 的卖点。
why_en: Have offline materialization and online serving share one feature definition so a single implementation drives both, eliminating the dual code path.
tradeoff: 单一特征定义（消 skew 但要统一编排/引擎） vs 各写一套（灵活但持续 skew 风险）
options: 加密集的线上监控，一旦精度掉了就人工去比对两份代码找差异
让离线物化与线上服务共用同一份特征定义，一份逻辑同时驱动两边
线上每次预测都实时回后台重算一遍离线特征，牺牲延迟换一致
两份代码都保留，但要求每次改动写详细文档，靠流程约束同步
options_en: Add heavy online monitoring and manually diff the two code copies whenever accuracy drops.
Have offline materialization and online serving share one feature definition so a single logic drives both.
Recompute the offline feature in the backend at every online prediction, trading latency for consistency.
Keep both code copies but require detailed docs on every change, syncing via process discipline.
whenOtherWins: 若线上和离线本就无法共用引擎（如线上要求 C++ 极致低延迟、离线是 Spark），退而求其次靠 golden 数据集自动比对两份实现的输出来兜底。
whenOtherWins_en: If online and offline genuinely can't share an engine (e.g. C++ ultra-low-latency online vs Spark offline), fall back to auto-diffing both implementations against a golden dataset.
optionExplanations: 监控只能事后发现 skew，改一次同步一次，人工比对代码是治标；根因（两份实现）还在。
对；一份定义 = 一条代码路径，skew 从源头消失，这是 feature store 存在的核心理由之一。
线上实时回算离线逻辑会把延迟拉爆（离线是重批处理），线上 SLA 根本扛不住。
靠文档和流程同步两份代码，人一忙就漏，skew 迟早复发；治理不了根因。
optionExplanations_en: Monitoring only catches skew after the fact; syncing per change and diffing code by hand treats symptoms while the root cause (two implementations) remains.
Correct — one definition means one code path, so skew disappears at the source; this is a core reason feature stores exist.
Recomputing offline logic online at prediction time blows the latency budget (offline is heavy batch); the online SLA can't take it.
Syncing two copies via docs and process fails the moment someone is busy, so skew recurs — it doesn't fix the root cause.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把特征按定义预先算好并存下来，供后续取用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Materialization is precomputing features per their definition and storing them for later reads.

termDefinitions.meaning: feature store 里统一跑批+流特征逻辑的引擎，共用一份代码防 skew。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transformation engine runs unified batch+streaming feature logic in the store, sharing one codebase to prevent skew.

scenario: 你要监控训练基线分布和线上服务分布之间的偏移，好在 skew 或 drift 发生时报警。
scenario_en: You want to monitor the shift between the training baseline distribution and the live serving distribution to alert on skew or drift.
q: PSI 和 KL 散度在监控特征分布上各偏重什么？
q_en: What does each of PSI and KL divergence emphasize for monitoring feature distributions?
why: PSI 是把分布分桶后算稳定性偏移的实用工业指标、有经验阈值好落地；KL 散度是信息论意义上的分布距离，对连续特征更细。两者互补：PSI 报警门槛清晰，KL 补充连续量的敏感度。
why_en: PSI is a bucketed, threshold-driven industrial stability metric, while KL divergence is an information-theoretic distance that complements PSI on continuous features.
tradeoff: PSI（分桶、阈值好用） vs KL 散度（信息论距离、对连续特征更细）
options: PSI 衡量模型精度、KL 衡量延迟，两者监控的是不同的服务指标
PSI 是分桶稳定性偏移、阈值好落地；KL 散度是信息论分布距离、对连续特征更细，两者互补
PSI 和 KL 完全等价，随便用一个就行，选择只是团队习惯问题
PSI 只能用于离线、KL 只能用于线上，两者不能对同一分布对照使用
options_en: PSI measures model accuracy and KL measures latency — they monitor different serving metrics.
PSI is a bucketed stability shift with usable thresholds; KL divergence is an information-theoretic distance finer on continuous features — they complement each other.
PSI and KL are fully equivalent; use either — the choice is just team habit.
PSI is offline-only and KL is online-only; they can't compare the same distribution.
optionExplanations: 两者都是分布偏移指标，跟精度、延迟无关；把它们说成服务指标是概念混淆。
对；PSI 好在有工业界经验阈值（如 >0.2 关注）易报警，KL 好在连续分布上更敏感，配合用最稳。
两者数学定义不同、敏感度不同，说等价会让你漏掉 KL 在连续特征上的优势。
两者都能对照任意两个分布（训练 vs 线上），没有离线/线上限制。
optionExplanations_en: Both are distribution-shift metrics unrelated to accuracy or latency; calling them serving metrics confuses the concepts.
Correct — PSI has industry thresholds (e.g. >0.2 worth attention) good for alerts, while KL is more sensitive on continuous distributions, so use them together.
Their math and sensitivity differ; calling them equivalent makes you miss KL's edge on continuous features.
Both can compare any two distributions (training vs live); there is no offline/online restriction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把分布分桶、逐桶比例差加权求和的稳定性偏移指标，>0.2 常视为显著偏移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PSI (Population Stability Index) buckets a distribution and sums weighted per-bucket proportion differences; above ~0.2 signals a notable shift.

termDefinitions.meaning: 信息论中衡量一个分布相对另一个分布差异的量，对连续特征偏移敏感。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: KL (Kullback-Leibler) divergence is the information-theoretic difference of one distribution relative to another, sensitive to continuous-feature shifts.

scenario: 线上监控发现某一个特征的 PSI 突然飙高，但它的上游数据源、用户行为都没变化，其它特征的 PSI 都正常。
scenario_en: Monitoring shows one feature's PSI suddenly spikes, but its upstream source and user behavior are unchanged and other features' PSI is normal.
q: 单个特征 PSI 突增、数据源没变，最可能是什么？
q_en: One feature's PSI spikes with an unchanged source — most likely what?
why: 最可能是 training-serving skew / 代码路径分叉或管线时序问题，不是真实用户行为 drift。真 drift 通常伴随源数据变化、且会牵连相关特征；单点突增而源不变，几乎总是计算侧出了岔。
why_en: Almost always a code-path divergence or pipeline-timing issue (skew), not genuine drift, because real drift moves the source and correlated features too.
tradeoff: 判为 skew（查代码/时序，可修复） vs 判为真实 drift（重训模型，成本高且这里方向错）
options: 真实用户行为发生了 drift，应立即触发全量重训模型来适配
几乎总是代码路径分叉或管线时序问题（skew），该去查特征计算实现而非重训
PSI 指标本身坏了，忽略即可，等它自己恢复正常
线上流量整体上涨，样本量变大自然让 PSI 升高，属正常波动
options_en: Real user-behavior drift occurred; immediately trigger a full retrain to adapt.
Almost always a code-path divergence or pipeline-timing issue (skew); investigate the feature computation, not retraining.
The PSI metric itself is broken; ignore it and wait for it to recover.
Overall traffic rose, so a bigger sample naturally raises PSI — normal noise.
whenOtherWins: 若同时多个相关特征的 PSI 一起动、且上游源数据确实变了（如节假日行为迁移），那才是真实 drift，重训才对症。
whenOtherWins_en: If several correlated features' PSI move together and the upstream source genuinely changed (e.g. holiday behavior shift), that is real drift and retraining is the right call.
optionExplanations: 源没变、只有单个特征动，不符合真 drift 的样子；贸然重训是把计算 bug 当数据变化治，方向错。
对；单点突增+源不变，是 skew 的典型指纹——两条计算路径或时序对不齐，先查实现最省事。
把报警当误报直接忽略，会放过真实的 skew，模型继续悄悄退化。
PSI 比较的是分布形状不是样本量，量大不会系统性抬高 PSI，这个解释站不住。
optionExplanations_en: Unchanged source with only one feature moving doesn't look like real drift; retraining treats a compute bug as a data change — wrong direction.
Correct — a single spike with an unchanged source is skew's fingerprint (two compute paths or timing misalignment); check the implementation first.
Dismissing the alert as a false alarm lets real skew slip through and the model keeps quietly degrading.
PSI compares distribution shape, not sample size; more volume does not systematically raise PSI, so this doesn't hold.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练基线与线上分布的偏移指标；单特征突增而源不变常指向 skew。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PSI (Population Stability Index) measures training-vs-live distribution shift; a single-feature spike with an unchanged source usually points to skew.

scenario: Uber 的 driver_average_rating_30d（司机近 30 天平均评分）被 ETA、动态定价、安全三个模型同时需要。没有统一登记的话，三个团队各写一版、口径略有出入。
scenario_en: Uber's driver_average_rating_30d is needed by ETA, surge-pricing, and safety models. Without a registry, three teams each build a slightly different version.
q: feature registry（特征注册表）解决的核心问题是什么？
q_en: What core problem does a feature registry solve?
why: 它提供跨团队的特征发现与共享：一份规范化定义，所有消费方读同一份物化值。没有它，多个团队重复造轮子、口径不一，同名特征算出不同结果，模型间难对齐。
why_en: It provides cross-team discovery and sharing so one canonical definition feeds all consumers the same materialized values, avoiding duplicated, inconsistent copies.
options: 把特征读延迟降到 10ms 以内，是纯粹的线上性能优化组件
提供跨团队特征发现与共享：一份规范定义、所有消费方读同一份物化值，避免重复与口径不一
自动给每个特征生成神经网络 embedding，替代手工特征工程
负责把违规 PII 特征自动删除，是合规专用模块
options_en: Cutting feature read latency below 10ms — a pure online performance component.
Cross-team discovery and sharing: one canonical definition and all consumers read the same materialized values, avoiding duplication and inconsistency.
Auto-generating a neural embedding for every feature, replacing manual feature engineering.
Auto-deleting non-compliant PII features — a compliance-only module.
optionExplanations: 低延迟读是 online store 的活，registry 管的是「定义/元数据/发现」，不是性能层。
对；registry 的价值就是让三个团队查到同一份 driver_average_rating_30d，读同一份值，不再各造一版。
registry 不生成 embedding，它登记的是特征定义与血缘，不做表示学习。
PII 治理靠访问控制与审计，registry 记录元数据和血缘可辅助合规，但不是「自动删」模块。
optionExplanations_en: Low-latency reads are the online store's job; the registry owns definitions/metadata/discovery, not the performance layer.
Correct — the registry's value is letting all three teams find the same driver_average_rating_30d and read the same values, not rebuild copies.
The registry generates no embeddings; it records feature definitions and lineage, not representation learning.
PII governance is access control and audit; the registry's metadata/lineage aids compliance but is not an 'auto-delete' module.

termDefinitions.meaning: 登记特征定义、元数据、版本与血缘，支持跨团队发现与复用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feature registry records feature definitions, metadata, versions, and lineage, enabling cross-team discovery and reuse.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征从原始数据到成品的来源与转换链路记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lineage records where a feature comes from and how it was transformed, from raw data to finished value.

scenario: 团队已经有成熟的离线管线（BigQuery/Redshift 里算好特征），现在只缺一个把特征物化到线上、并能跨团队发现的轻量层，不想再引入一套新的计算引擎。
scenario_en: A team already has mature offline pipelines (features computed in BigQuery/Redshift) and only needs a lightweight layer to materialize features online and enable discovery — no new compute engine.
q: 这种情况该选哪个 feature store 工具？
q_en: Which feature store tool fits here?
why: 选 Feast：开源、轻量，做的是「serving + registry」层，本身不是计算引擎，从 BigQuery/Redshift 物化到 Redis/DynamoDB。你已有成熟计算管线时它最贴合，不重复造引擎。
why_en: Feast: open-source, lightweight, a serving+registry layer (not a compute engine) that materializes from BigQuery/Redshift to Redis/DynamoDB, ideal when you already have mature pipelines.
tradeoff: Feast（轻量、复用已有管线） vs Tecton（自带引擎但要托管、更重）
options: Tecton：因为它自带 transformation engine，能顺便把现有管线全部替换掉
Feast：开源轻量的 serving+registry 层，从 BigQuery/Redshift 物化到 Redis/DynamoDB，复用已有管线
Hopsworks：因为只有它支持线上低延迟读，其它工具都不行
自研一套：现成工具都不适合已有成熟管线的团队
options_en: Tecton: it bundles a transformation engine and can conveniently replace all existing pipelines.
Feast: an open-source lightweight serving+registry layer materializing from BigQuery/Redshift to Redis/DynamoDB, reusing existing pipelines.
Hopsworks: only it supports low-latency online reads; the others can't.
Build in-house: no off-the-shelf tool suits a team with mature pipelines.
whenOtherWins: 若团队还没有统一计算管线、正被离线/线上双代码路径的 skew 反复咬到，则应选自带 transformation engine 的 Tecton，让一份代码同跑批+流。
whenOtherWins_en: If the team lacks a unified compute pipeline and keeps getting bitten by dual-code-path skew, pick Tecton with its built-in transformation engine so one codebase runs batch+streaming.
optionExplanations: 已有成熟管线时再上 Tecton 的重型引擎是叠床架屋，团队并不需要它替换现有计算。
对；Feast 只补「物化+服务+登记」这段，正好卡在已有管线之上，最省事。
低延迟线上读是所有主流 feature store 的基础能力，不是 Hopsworks 独有，这个理由不成立。
已有成熟管线恰恰是 Feast 的最佳场景，没必要自研。
optionExplanations_en: Adding Tecton's heavy engine atop mature pipelines is redundant; the team doesn't need it to replace existing compute.
Correct — Feast covers only 'materialize + serve + register,' sitting neatly atop existing pipelines with least effort.
Low-latency online reads are table stakes for all major feature stores, not unique to Hopsworks — the reason fails.
Mature existing pipelines are exactly Feast's sweet spot; there's no need to build in-house.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开源轻量 feature store，做 serving+registry，从离线库物化到线上 KV，非计算引擎。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feast is a lightweight open-source feature store providing serving+registry, materializing from offline stores to online KV, and is not a compute engine.

termDefinitions.meaning: 商业托管 feature store（源自 Uber Michelangelo），自带批+流统一 transformation engine。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tecton is a managed feature store (from Uber's Michelangelo) with a built-in unified batch+streaming transformation engine.

scenario: 团队一直被 training-serving skew 折磨：离线一套代码、线上一套代码，同名特征两边算出的值总对不齐。希望有一个工具用同一份代码同时跑批处理和流处理来根治。
scenario_en: A team keeps suffering training-serving skew: separate offline and online code, same-name features never matching. They want one tool running the same code for batch and streaming to fix it.
q: 最能直接根治双代码路径 skew 的托管方案是？
q_en: Which managed option most directly kills dual-code-path skew?
why: 选 Tecton：它内置 transformation engine，同一份代码同时跑批处理与流处理，从根上消掉离线/线上的双代码路径，直接杀死 skew，还自带编排、监控、point-in-time join。
why_en: Tecton's built-in transformation engine runs the same code for batch and streaming, eliminating the dual code path and directly killing skew.
tradeoff: Tecton（一份代码跑批+流、消 skew，但托管付费+更重） vs Feast（轻量但要自带管线、不消 skew）
options: Feast：它足够轻量，skew 靠它的 registry 就能自动消除
Hopsworks：靠它的数据版本化功能，skew 会被版本对齐自动修复
Tecton：内置 transformation engine，一份代码同跑批+流，从根上消掉双代码路径
任意工具都行：skew 只要加线上监控就能解决，不需要统一引擎
options_en: Feast: it's lightweight enough that its registry auto-eliminates skew.
Hopsworks: its data versioning auto-fixes skew by aligning versions.
Tecton: its built-in transformation engine runs one codebase for batch+streaming, eliminating the dual code path.
Any tool: skew is solved by adding online monitoring — no unified engine needed.
whenOtherWins: 若你已有一套成熟且统一的计算管线、并不缺统一引擎，只想要轻量的物化+登记层，Feast 更合适，不必上 Tecton 的托管成本。
whenOtherWins_en: If you already have a mature, unified compute pipeline and only need a lightweight materialize+register layer, Feast fits better without Tecton's managed cost.
optionExplanations: Feast 是 serving+registry 层、不含计算引擎，registry 管发现不管「两边用同一份计算」，消不了 skew。
数据版本化管的是数据可复现，不等于让离线/线上共用一份特征计算逻辑，解决不了双代码路径。
对；Tecton 的卖点正是统一 transformation engine——一份代码跑批+流，双代码路径没了，skew 从源头消失。
监控只能事后发现 skew，发现了还是要回去统一实现；不上统一引擎就治标不治本。
optionExplanations_en: Feast is a serving+registry layer with no compute engine; the registry handles discovery, not 'both sides use one computation,' so it can't kill skew.
Data versioning makes data reproducible, not offline/online sharing one feature computation, so it doesn't fix the dual code path.
Correct — Tecton's whole pitch is a unified transformation engine: one codebase for batch+streaming removes the dual path and skew at its source.
Monitoring only detects skew after the fact; you still must unify the implementation, so without a unified engine it treats symptoms only.

termDefinitions.meaning: 托管 feature store，内置统一 transformation engine，同代码跑批+流以消 skew。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tecton is a managed feature store whose unified transformation engine runs the same code for batch and streaming to eliminate skew.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开源全平台 feature store，强在特征 registry 与数据版本化、Spark/Flink 集成。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hopsworks is a full-platform open-source feature store, strong on registry, data versioning, and Spark/Flink integration.

scenario: feature store 内部分成 offline store 和 online store 两块，你要说清各自的存储选型和职责边界。
scenario_en: A feature store splits into an offline store and an online store; you must explain each one's storage choice and responsibility.
q: offline store 与 online store 的分工是什么？
q_en: How do the offline store and online store divide responsibility?
why: offline store 用数据仓库（BigQuery/Redshift/S3）生成训练数据、跑 point-in-time join，吞吐优先；online store 用 KV（Redis/DynamoDB）在推理时供特征，延迟优先、sub-10ms 读。一个为训练的批量正确性，一个为线上的低延迟。
why_en: The offline store is a warehouse (BigQuery/Redshift/S3) for training-data generation and point-in-time joins, while the online store is a KV store (Redis/DynamoDB) serving features at inference with sub-10ms reads.
tradeoff: offline store（仓库、吞吐+PIT 正确性） vs online store（KV、低延迟 sub-10ms）
options: offline store 用 KV 做低延迟读、online store 用数据仓库做批量训练，两者角色互换
两者都用数据仓库，区别只是一个存历史一个存当天，延迟需求相同
offline store 用仓库生成训练数据+跑 PIT join；online store 用 KV 在推理时 sub-10ms 供特征
两者都用 Redis，offline 只是多加了一层缓存，本质是同一套存储
options_en: The offline store uses KV for low-latency reads and the online store uses a warehouse for batch training — roles swapped.
Both use a data warehouse; they differ only in history vs today, with the same latency needs.
The offline store uses a warehouse for training-data generation and PIT joins; the online store uses KV to serve features at sub-10ms during inference.
Both use Redis; the offline store just adds a cache layer — essentially the same storage.
optionExplanations: 角色说反了：低延迟点查是 KV/online 的活，批量训练取数是仓库/offline 的活，不能互换。
两者延迟需求根本不同：训练要吞吐、线上要毫秒；用同类存储会各自不达标。
对；仓库擅长大批量扫描与时间点连接，KV 擅长毫秒级单点取值，各自选型贴合其职责。
线上确实常用 Redis，但离线是仓库不是 Redis 缓存；把两者当同一套会混淆训练与服务路径。
optionExplanations_en: Roles reversed: low-latency point reads are KV/online's job, batch training reads are warehouse/offline's job — not interchangeable.
Their latency needs differ fundamentally: training wants throughput, online wants milliseconds; one storage type can't meet both.
Correct — a warehouse excels at large scans and point-in-time joins; KV excels at millisecond point lookups; each choice fits its job.
Online often uses Redis, but offline is a warehouse, not a Redis cache; treating them as one conflates the training and serving paths.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据仓库（BigQuery/Redshift/S3），生成训练数据、跑 point-in-time join。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The offline store is a warehouse (BigQuery/Redshift/S3) for training-data generation and point-in-time joins.

termDefinitions.meaning: KV 存储（Redis/DynamoDB），推理时 sub-10ms 供特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The online store is a KV store (Redis/DynamoDB) that serves features at sub-10ms during inference.

scenario: 在线推理路径里，feature store 的 online store 承诺 sub-10ms 的特征读延迟。
scenario_en: On the online inference path, the feature store's online store promises sub-10ms feature reads.
q: sub-10ms 这个读延迟要求，对 online store 的选型意味着什么？
q_en: What does the sub-10ms read requirement imply for the online store's design?
why: sub-10ms 是给定的服务目标（不是公式推出来的），它直接排除数据仓库（扫描通常几十 ms 到秒级），逼你选内存/KV 存储（Redis/DynamoDB）做点查。它是「哪种存储能进线上路径」的硬约束，下游决定缓存与索引结构。
why_en: Sub-10ms is a given serving target that rules out warehouses (scans take tens of ms to seconds) and forces an in-memory/KV store for point lookups on the online path.
options: 它要求 online store 用数据仓库，因为仓库的列式扫描本来就是毫秒级的
它是给定的服务目标，排除仓库、逼你用内存/KV 存储（Redis/DynamoDB）做毫秒点查
它意味着模型必须变小到能塞进 CPU 缓存，和特征存储选型无关
它只是个软性建议，超过 10ms 也无所谓，用什么存储都行
options_en: It requires the online store to be a data warehouse, since columnar scans are already millisecond-fast.
It's a given serving target that rules out warehouses and forces an in-memory/KV store (Redis/DynamoDB) for millisecond point lookups.
It means the model must shrink to fit CPU cache — unrelated to feature-store choice.
It's just a soft suggestion; exceeding 10ms is fine and any storage works.
optionExplanations: 仓库扫描通常几十 ms 到秒级，根本进不了 10ms 预算，正好是被排除的一类，不是选它。
对；把 sub-10ms 当硬约束，就只能选 KV/内存点查存储，这是它对架构的直接含义。
10ms 约束的是特征读这一跳，不是模型大小；跑偏到 CPU 缓存是答非所问。
线上推理路径里 10ms 是硬预算的一部分，超了会挤压后续 auction/排序时间，不是可有可无。
optionExplanations_en: Warehouse scans run tens of ms to seconds, blowing the 10ms budget — it's the ruled-out class, not the choice.
Correct — treating sub-10ms as a hard constraint forces a KV/in-memory point-lookup store; that's its direct architectural implication.
The 10ms constrains the feature-read hop, not model size; jumping to CPU cache misses the question.
On the inference path 10ms is part of a hard budget; exceeding it squeezes downstream auction/ranking time, so it's not optional.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上取特征的延迟目标，通常要求内存/KV 点查而非仓库扫描。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sub-10ms read is the online feature-fetch latency target, requiring in-memory/KV point lookups rather than warehouse scans.

scenario: 画 feature store 架构图时，你要列出它的四个核心组件。
scenario_en: Sketching a feature store architecture, you must list its four core components.
q: 以下哪些是 feature store 的核心架构组件？(多选)
q_en: Which are core architectural components of a feature store? (multiple)
why: 四大件：offline store（仓库，训练取数+PIT）、online store（KV，线上低延迟）、feature registry（定义/元数据/发现）、transformation engine（批+流统一逻辑、防 skew、处理晚到）。GPU 训练集群属于训练侧，不是 feature store 的组件。
why_en: The four are the offline store, online store, feature registry, and transformation engine; a GPU training cluster is a training-side concern, not a feature-store component.
options: offline store（数据仓库，训练取数 + point-in-time join）
online store（KV 存储，线上 sub-10ms 供特征）
feature registry（定义、元数据、版本、跨团队发现）
transformation engine（批+流统一逻辑，防 skew、处理晚到事件）
GPU 训练集群（跑梯度下降训练模型权重）
options_en: Offline store (warehouse: training reads + point-in-time joins).
Online store (KV store: sub-10ms online feature serving).
Feature registry (definitions, metadata, versions, cross-team discovery).
Transformation engine (unified batch+streaming logic; prevents skew, handles late events).
GPU training cluster (runs gradient descent to train model weights).
optionExplanations: 对；offline store 是训练侧取数与时间点连接的地基。
对；online store 是线上推理的低延迟取数层。
对；registry 让特征可发现、可复用、可追血缘。
对；transformation engine 统一批+流计算，是防 skew 与处理晚到的关键。
错；训练 GPU 集群是模型训练基础设施，不归 feature store 管，别混进架构组件。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the offline store is the foundation for training reads and point-in-time joins.
Correct — the online store is the low-latency read layer for online inference.
Correct — the registry makes features discoverable, reusable, and traceable.
Correct — the transformation engine unifies batch+streaming compute, key to preventing skew and handling late events.
Wrong — a GPU training cluster is model-training infra, not part of the feature store; don't fold it into the components.

termDefinitions.meaning: 统一跑批+流特征逻辑的引擎，防 skew，负责晚到事件处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transformation engine runs unified batch+streaming feature logic, preventing skew and handling late-arriving events.

scenario: 你要写训练数据生成的 join：每个 label 事件（label_ts）只能取该时刻之前的最新特征值，绝不能取到之后的。
scenario_en: You write the training-data join: each label event (label_ts) may only take the latest feature value before that moment, never after.
q: 哪个 ON 谓词正确实现了 point-in-time 正确性？
q_en: Which ON predicate correctly enforces point-in-time correctness?
why: 关键是 f.event_ts <= l.label_ts：只取「标签发生前已知」的最新值。缺了时间条件（选项 0）会取到今天的最新值、泄漏未来；用 >= 或同日（选项 2/3）则直接把标签之后的交易算进去。
why_en: The key is f.event_ts <= l.label_ts, taking only the latest value known before the label; without a time condition you leak future data.
tradeoff: 带 event_ts <= label_ts（正确但要事件时间戳） vs 裸 join（简单但泄漏未来）
codeSample:
-- 点时间连接：每个 label 只取「事件时刻之前」的最新特征
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, f.txn_count_30d
FROM labels l
ASOF JOIN features f              -- ASOF = 按时间就近匹配最近一条
  ON f.user_id = l.user_id
  AND f.event_ts <= l.label_ts    -- 关键：只用标签发生前已知的值
options: ON f.user_id = l.user_id （只按用户连接，取最新一条）
ON f.user_id = l.user_id AND f.event_ts <= l.label_ts （ASOF 取标签前最新值）
ON f.user_id = l.user_id AND f.event_ts >= l.label_ts （取标签之后的值）
ON f.user_id = l.user_id AND DATE(f.event_ts) = DATE(l.label_ts) （同一天即可）
options_en: ON f.user_id = l.user_id (join by user only, take the latest row).
ON f.user_id = l.user_id AND f.event_ts <= l.label_ts (ASOF, latest value before the label).
ON f.user_id = l.user_id AND f.event_ts >= l.label_ts (take values after the label).
ON f.user_id = l.user_id AND DATE(f.event_ts) = DATE(l.label_ts) (same calendar day).
whenOtherWins: 只有当特征是永不随时间变的静态属性（如账户创建国家）时，裸 user_id join（选项 0）才安全，因为没有未来值可泄漏。
whenOtherWins_en: A plain user_id join (option 0) is safe only for static attributes that never change over time (e.g. account creation country), since there is no future value to leak.
optionExplanations: 没有时间条件，会 join 到当前最新值——把标签之后发生的交易也算进来，泄漏未来。
对；<= label_ts 精确截断在标签时刻之前，ASOF 取最近一条，训练与线上预测那一刻看到的一致。
>= 反了，专门取标签之后的值，等于把答案直接喂给模型，泄漏最严重。
同日粒度太粗：标签当天、标签时刻之后发生的交易仍在同一天，照样被算进特征。
optionExplanations_en: With no time condition it joins the current latest value — counting transactions after the label — leaking the future.
Correct — <= label_ts cuts exactly before the label and ASOF takes the nearest row, matching what serving sees at prediction time.
>= is backwards, deliberately taking post-label values — feeding the answer to the model, the worst leak.
Same-day granularity is too coarse: transactions later that same day, after the label, still fall in the day and get counted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按时间就近匹配的连接：对每个左表时间点取右表「不晚于它」的最近一条。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ASOF join matches by nearest time, taking for each left timestamp the closest right row not later than it.

scenario: 线下 AUC 95%、线上只有 78%，你要给出一条从观测到定位再到修复的诊断链。
scenario_en: Offline AUC 95%, online only 78%; give a diagnosis chain from observation to root cause to fix.
q: 把「离线高线上崩」的诊断步骤排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the steps to diagnose 'great offline, collapses online':
steps: 先看 PSI/KL：训练与线上分布是否偏移
PSI 显示两边分布几乎一致，排除 skew 与真实 drift
既非分布偏移，指向未来数据泄漏（训练用了标签之后的信息）
回查特征 join：补上 point-in-time join（按 event_ts 截断）
why: 关键在于：泄漏不改变分布，所以 PSI 一致恰恰排除了 skew/drift，反过来指向泄漏。诊断顺序是先用 PSI 排除分布问题，再锁定 point-in-time join 缺失并补上。
why_en: Leakage does not shift distributions, so identical PSI rules out skew/drift and points to leakage, whose fix is adding point-in-time joins.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["离线95% 线上78%"] --> B["查 PSI/KL"]
  B --> C{"分布偏移?"}
  C -->|"一致"| D["排除 skew/drift"]
  D --> E["指向未来数据泄漏"]
  E --> F["补 point-in-time join"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布偏移指标；泄漏不改分布，故 PSI 一致反而指向泄漏而非 drift。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PSI (Population Stability Index) measures distribution shift; since leakage doesn't shift distributions, identical PSI points to leakage, not drift.

scenario: 某模型离线 AUC 95%、上线只有 78%，同时 PSI 显示训练与线上的特征分布几乎完全一致（没有偏移）。
scenario_en: A model has offline AUC 95% but online 78%, while PSI shows training and live feature distributions are nearly identical (no shift).
q: PSI 一致却离线线上落差巨大，最可能的根因是？
q_en: With identical PSI but a big offline-online gap, the most likely root cause?
why: 未来数据泄漏（缺 point-in-time join）。关键推理：泄漏不改变特征的边缘分布，所以 PSI 抓不到它；PSI 一致恰好排除了 skew 和真实 drift，把矛头指向泄漏。
why_en: Future-data leakage from missing point-in-time joins, because leakage doesn't shift the marginal distribution, so identical PSI rules out skew/drift and points to leakage.
tradeoff: 判为泄漏（补 PIT join，一次性根治） vs 判为 drift（反复重训，方向错、治不好）
options: 训练-服务 skew：两边代码路径不同算出不同值
真实 data drift：线上分布变了，需要持续重训
未来数据泄漏（缺 point-in-time join）：泄漏不改分布，所以 PSI 抓不到
线上机器算力不足导致推理降级、精度下降
options_en: Training-serving skew: different code paths compute different values.
Real data drift: the live distribution shifted, requiring continual retraining.
Future-data leakage (missing point-in-time joins): leakage doesn't shift distributions, so PSI can't catch it.
Insufficient online compute downgrades inference and lowers accuracy.
whenOtherWins: 如果 PSI 明显升高、且多个相关特征一起偏移，那才该判为 skew 或真实 drift，去查代码路径或重训模型。
whenOtherWins_en: If PSI is clearly elevated and several correlated features shift together, then it is skew or real drift, and you'd check code paths or retrain.
optionExplanations: skew 通常会让线上分布偏离训练、PSI 升高；这里 PSI 一致，与 skew 的指纹不符。
真实 drift 同样会体现在 PSI 上；PSI 没动就说明分布没变，不是 drift。
对；泄漏发生在训练取数阶段、不改变分布形状，PSI 天然抓不到——这正是它区别于 skew/drift 的判别点。
算力问题只加延迟/超时，不会把学到真信号的模型精度打到 78%，量级和机制都对不上。
optionExplanations_en: Skew usually pushes the live distribution off training and raises PSI; identical PSI doesn't match skew's fingerprint.
Real drift would also show up in PSI; unchanged PSI means the distribution didn't move, so not drift.
Correct — leakage happens at the training-read stage and doesn't change distribution shape, so PSI can't see it — the exact discriminator from skew/drift.
Compute issues only add latency/timeouts and wouldn't knock a model with real signal to 78% — wrong magnitude and mechanism.

termDefinitions.term: future-data leakage / 未来数据泄漏
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练用了标签之后才可知的信息；不改变分布，故 PSI 抓不到。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Future-data leakage uses information known only after the label; it doesn't change distributions, so PSI can't catch it.

scenario: 有人提议用 Feast 一站式解决「特征计算 + 存储 + 服务」，把 Spark/Flink 都省掉。
scenario_en: Someone proposes Feast as a one-stop 'compute + store + serve' to drop Spark/Flink entirely.
q: Feast 在架构里的定位边界是什么？
q_en: What is Feast's scope boundary in the architecture?
why: Feast 是 serving + registry 层，本身不是计算引擎：它把你已经算好的特征从离线库（BigQuery/Redshift）物化到线上库（Redis/DynamoDB）并登记，特征本身还得靠你的 Spark/Flink 等管线算。想省掉计算引擎是误解它的定位。
why_en: Feast is a serving+registry layer, not a compute engine; it materializes already-computed features from offline stores to online stores and registers them, but you still compute features with your own pipelines.
options: Feast 自带计算引擎，能替代 Spark/Flink 从原始数据算出所有特征
Feast 是 serving+registry 层，不算特征；它把已算好的特征从离线库物化到线上库并登记
Feast 只做线上 KV 存储，不含 registry，跨团队发现要另配工具
Feast 是纯监控工具，只输出 PSI/KL 报警，不参与存储与服务
options_en: Feast has its own compute engine and can replace Spark/Flink to compute all features from raw data.
Feast is a serving+registry layer that computes nothing; it materializes already-computed features from offline to online stores and registers them.
Feast is online KV storage only, with no registry; cross-team discovery needs another tool.
Feast is a pure monitoring tool emitting only PSI/KL alerts, not storage or serving.
optionExplanations: 正好相反：Feast 明确不是计算引擎，它不接管 Spark/Flink 的特征计算职责。
对；它做的是「物化+服务+登记」，计算仍靠你自己的管线，这是它轻量的原因也是它的边界。
Feast 是带 registry 的，跨团队发现正是它提供的能力，不用另配。
监控不是 Feast 的定位；它实打实参与线上服务与离线到线上的物化。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite: Feast is explicitly not a compute engine and doesn't take over Spark/Flink's feature computation.
Correct — it does 'materialize + serve + register'; computation stays in your pipelines, which is why it's lightweight and where its boundary lies.
Feast does include a registry; cross-team discovery is exactly what it provides, no separate tool needed.
Monitoring isn't Feast's role; it genuinely serves online and materializes offline-to-online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开源轻量 feature store：serving+registry，物化已算好的特征，不做计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feast is a lightweight open-source feature store (serving+registry) that materializes already-computed features and does no computation itself.

scenario: feature store 里存了含 PII（个人身份信息）的特征，比如从用户地址、邮箱派生的字段，团队要满足 GDPR/CCPA。
scenario_en: The feature store holds PII-derived features (from user address, email); the team must satisfy GDPR/CCPA.
q: 在 feature store 中处理 PII 特征，合规上必须配套什么？
q_en: For PII features in a feature store, what does compliance require alongside them?
why: PII 特征必须配访问控制、保留策略、审计追踪（GDPR/CCPA 要求）。合规不是事后补的，删除/最小化/可审计要从特征管线设计时就建进去，否则一个删除请求会波及特征存储和下游模型。
why_en: PII features require access controls, retention policies, and audit trails per GDPR/CCPA, built into the pipeline from the start rather than bolted on.
options: 什么都不用加，特征一旦进了 feature store 就自动脱离了原始 PII 的合规范围
只需在展示层打码，存储和取数环节照常明文即可
访问控制、保留策略、审计追踪——合规要素从特征管线设计时就建进去
把 PII 特征全部搬到线上 KV 存储就合规了，仓库里不留即可
options_en: Nothing extra; once in the feature store, features automatically leave the original PII's compliance scope.
Just mask at the display layer; storage and reads can stay plaintext.
Access controls, retention policies, and audit trails — compliance built into the pipeline from design time.
Moving all PII features to the online KV store makes it compliant, as long as nothing stays in the warehouse.
optionExplanations: 派生特征仍可能编码 PII、可被反推身份，进了 feature store 也不脱离合规义务。
只在展示层打码，存储和取数明文照样违规——GDPR/CCPA 管的是数据全生命周期。
对；访问控制+保留+审计是 PII 特征的合规三件套，必须从管线设计时嵌入，删除请求才能贯通到下游。
换存储位置不改变数据是 PII 的事实，KV 里同样要访问控制与审计，搬家不等于合规。
optionExplanations_en: Derived features can still encode PII and enable re-identification; entering the store doesn't drop the obligation.
Masking only at display while storage/reads stay plaintext still violates GDPR/CCPA, which govern the full data lifecycle.
Correct — access control + retention + audit is the PII compliance trio, embedded from pipeline design so deletion requests reach downstream.
Relocating storage doesn't change that the data is PII; KV still needs access control and audit — moving isn't complying.

termDefinitions.meaning: 能识别到具体个人的信息（姓名、邮箱、SSN、地址等）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PII (Personally Identifiable Information) is data that can identify a specific person (name, email, SSN, address).

termDefinitions.fullName: General Data Protection Regulation / California Consumer Privacy Act
termDefinitions.meaning: 欧盟与加州的数据隐私法规，要求删除权、数据最小化、访问控制与审计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GDPR (EU) and CCPA (California) are data-privacy laws mandating deletion rights, data minimization, access controls, and audit trails.

scenario: 面试里要判断一个系统是否值得引入 feature store（它有架构成本，不是无脑上）。
scenario_en: In an interview you must judge whether a system warrants a feature store (it has architectural cost, not a default add).
q: 什么信号出现时，引入 feature store 才划算？
q_en: What signals make a feature store worth introducing?
why: 当存在多条特征管线（批+流并存）、多个模型共享特征、或对新鲜度/正确性敏感的领域（欺诈、推荐、搜索）时，feature store 才真正物有所值——它专治 point-in-time、skew、复用这三类痛。单模型单管线时是过度设计。
why_en: It pays off with multiple pipelines (batch+streaming), multiple models sharing features, or freshness/correctness-sensitive domains like fraud, rec, and search — otherwise it's over-engineering.
tradeoff: 上 feature store（治 PIT/skew/复用，但加架构成本） vs 不上（单模型单管线时更省）
options: 只要项目用到机器学习，无论规模都应该第一时间上 feature store
存在多条特征管线、多模型共享特征、或新鲜度/正确性敏感的领域时，才划算
只有当模型是深度神经网络时才需要，经典 ML 一律不用
只有当线上 QPS 超过一百万时才考虑，其它情况都用不上
options_en: Any ML project should adopt a feature store first thing, regardless of scale.
It pays off with multiple feature pipelines, multiple models sharing features, or freshness/correctness-sensitive domains.
Only when the model is a deep neural net; classical ML never needs one.
Only when online QPS exceeds one million; otherwise it's unnecessary.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有一个模型、一条批处理管线、无跨团队共享，直接用现成表/文件即可，引入 feature store 是过度工程。
whenOtherWins_en: If there's a single model, one batch pipeline, and no cross-team sharing, plain tables/files suffice and a feature store is over-engineering.
optionExplanations: 无脑上是过度设计：单模型单管线场景下 feature store 的复杂度换不来相应收益。
对；它解决的三大痛（PIT、skew、复用）都在「多管线/多模型/高敏感领域」才凸显，这时才值。
模型是不是神经网络与要不要 feature store 无关；经典 ML 的 CTR 系统一样受益于特征复用与一致性。
QPS 高只是一个维度；即便中等 QPS，只要有多管线/多模型共享，feature store 也很划算。
optionExplanations_en: Adopting it blindly is over-engineering: for one model and one pipeline, its complexity doesn't pay back.
Correct — its three pains (PIT, skew, reuse) surface with multiple pipelines/models or sensitive domains, which is when it's worth it.
Whether the model is neural is irrelevant; a classical-ML CTR system also benefits from feature reuse and consistency.
High QPS is just one axis; even at moderate QPS, multiple pipelines/models sharing features make a feature store worthwhile.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征反映最新事件的及时程度，欺诈/推荐/搜索等领域对它敏感。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Freshness is how up-to-date a feature is relative to recent events, critical in fraud, rec, and search.

scenario: training-serving skew 的可怕之处是「悄无声息」——没有报错、指标只是慢慢变差，很难第一时间归因。
scenario_en: The danger of training-serving skew is that it's silent — no errors, metrics just slowly worsen, hard to attribute at first.
q: 为什么 skew 特别难查，配套的防线该是什么？
q_en: Why is skew so hard to catch, and what defense pairs with it?
why: 难查在于两边算出的值都「看着合理」，只是系统性微差、不会抛异常，模型只是缓慢退化。防线是单一特征定义（从源头消 skew）+ PSI/KL 分布监控（早发现残留偏移），两者一治本一兜底。
why_en: Skew is hard to catch because both sides produce plausible values that differ only subtly without errors, so pair a single feature definition with PSI/KL monitoring.
tradeoff: 单一定义（根治 skew） + PSI/KL 监控（兜底早报警） vs 只靠监控（治标、发现晚）
options: 难查是因为它总会抛异常刷屏日志；防线是加大日志级别把异常抓下来
难查因为两边值都看着合理、只有系统性微差不报错；防线=单一特征定义+PSI/KL 分布监控
难查是因为模型太大；防线是把模型剪枝变小就能顺带消除 skew
难查是因为线上 QPS 太高；防线是限流降到低 QPS 就不会有 skew
options_en: Hard to catch because it always throws exceptions flooding logs; the defense is raising log level to capture them.
Hard to catch because both values look plausible and differ only subtly with no errors; the defense is a single feature definition plus PSI/KL monitoring.
Hard to catch because the model is too big; the defense is pruning the model, which also removes skew.
Hard to catch because online QPS is too high; the defense is rate-limiting to low QPS so skew disappears.
optionExplanations: skew 恰恰不抛异常——它无声退化，靠日志级别根本抓不到，方向错。
对；正因两边都「像对的」，才要靠一份定义堵住源头，再用分布监控发现漏网的偏移。
模型大小与 skew 无关；剪枝改变的是模型容量，消不掉两条计算路径的差异。
QPS 高低与特征计算是否分叉无关；限流不会让两份实现变成一份。
optionExplanations_en: Skew precisely does not throw exceptions — it degrades silently, so log levels can't catch it; wrong direction.
Correct — because both look right, you plug the source with one definition and use distribution monitoring to catch residual shift.
Model size is unrelated to skew; pruning changes capacity, not the divergence of two compute paths.
QPS is unrelated to whether feature computation diverges; rate-limiting won't merge two implementations into one.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型不报错、指标缓慢变差的失效方式，skew 是典型来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Silent degradation is failure where the model throws no errors while metrics slowly worsen; skew is a classic source.

q: 补全三个 feature store 工具的定位差异：
q_en: Fill in how the three feature store tools differ.
text: {{Feast}} 开源轻量、只做 serving+registry、不是计算引擎；{{Tecton}} 托管、自带统一 transformation engine 用同一份代码跑批+流以消 skew；{{Hopsworks}} 开源全平台、强在 registry 与数据版本化。
text_en: {{Feast}} is lightweight open-source serving+registry (no compute engine); {{Tecton}} is managed with a unified transformation engine running one codebase for batch+streaming to kill skew; {{Hopsworks}} is a full-platform open-source store strong on registry and data versioning.
why: 记忆钩子：Feast=轻量物化层、Tecton=消 skew 的统一引擎、Hopsworks=全平台+版本化。选型先问「我缺的是服务层、统一引擎、还是全平台治理」。
why_en: Memory hook: Feast is the lightweight materialization layer, Tecton the unified skew-killing engine, Hopsworks the full-platform versioning store — choose by what you lack.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开源全平台 feature store，强在特征 registry、数据版本化、Spark/Flink 集成与 Python SDK。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hopsworks is a full-platform open-source feature store strong on registry, data versioning, Spark/Flink integration, and a Python SDK.

q: 把「面试里讲 feature store」的结构排成推荐顺序：
q_en: Order the recommended structure for discussing feature stores in an interview:
steps: 先点名它解决的三大问题：point-in-time 正确性、skew、复用
描述 offline store / online store 的读写分离（仓库 vs KV）
讲 registry 支撑跨团队特征发现与复用
用 PSI/KL 做 skew 与分布偏移监控收尾
why: 先立框架（三大问题）再落架构（offline/online 分离）→ 治理（registry）→ 运维监控（PSI/KL），层层递进，别一上来钻 vendor API。
why_en: Frame the three problems first, then the offline/online split, then the registry for governance, then PSI/KL monitoring — don't dive into vendor APIs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两种分布偏移监控指标，用于发现 skew 与 drift。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PSI (Population Stability Index) and KL (Kullback-Leibler) divergence are distribution-shift metrics used to detect skew and drift.

scenario: 面试里讨论 feature store 时，你在纠结要不要深入背 Feast/Tecton 的具体 API 用法。
scenario_en: Discussing feature stores in an interview, you wonder whether to go deep on Feast/Tecton API specifics.
q: 讲 feature store 时，深度该落在哪里？
q_en: Where should the depth land when discussing feature stores?
why: 落在概念与取舍：三大问题、offline/online 分离、registry、PSI/KL 监控；只需知道每个工具的定位（niche），不背 vendor API。面试考的是架构判断，不是背 SDK 调用。
why_en: Land on concepts and trade-offs — the three problems, offline/online split, registry, PSI/KL — and know each tool's niche, not vendor API details.
tradeoff: 讲概念+取舍+工具定位（面试要的） vs 背 vendor API（细节多但不加分）
options: 深入背 Feast/Tecton 的函数签名和 SDK 调用，越细越显专业
落在概念与取舍（三大问题、offline/online、registry、PSI/KL），工具只需知道定位
只讲你用过的那一个工具的全部命令，其它工具一概不提
把时间全花在对比各家定价和 SLA，架构反而略过
options_en: Go deep on Feast/Tecton function signatures and SDK calls — the finer the more expert.
Land on concepts and trade-offs (the three problems, offline/online, registry, PSI/KL); for tools, just know their niche.
Cover every command of the one tool you've used and skip all others.
Spend all the time comparing vendor pricing and SLAs, skipping the architecture.
whenOtherWins: 只有当面试官明确追问某工具的实现细节（如「Feast 怎么做物化调度」）时，才展开该工具的具体机制。
whenOtherWins_en: Only when the interviewer explicitly probes a tool's internals (e.g. 'how does Feast schedule materialization') do you expand on that tool's mechanics.
optionExplanations: 背 API 是记忆活，面试考的是架构判断；堆函数签名反而挤掉了讲取舍的时间。
对；讲清三大问题和 offline/online/registry/监控的取舍，再点出工具各自定位，才是面试要的深度。
只讲一个工具会显得视野窄，且回答不了「为什么选它而不是另一个」的比较问题。
定价/SLA 是采购视角，面试考的是系统设计取舍，把架构略过是主次颠倒。
optionExplanations_en: Memorizing APIs is rote; interviews test architectural judgment, and piling on signatures crowds out trade-off discussion.
Correct — explaining the three problems and the offline/online/registry/monitoring trade-offs, then each tool's niche, is the depth interviews want.
Covering only one tool looks narrow and can't answer the comparative 'why this over that.'
Pricing/SLA is a procurement lens; the interview tests design trade-offs, so skipping architecture inverts the priorities.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个工具最擅长、最适合的场景边界，面试只需讲到这一层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A tool's niche is the scenario it fits best; interviews only need this level of detail.

scenario: 特征里有加密的 PII 字段。有人提议在线上服务路径实时解密再喂给模型，以拿到「最真实」的原始值。
scenario_en: Some PII features are encrypted. Someone proposes decrypting them on the online serving path to feed the model the 'truest' raw values.
q: 线上服务路径该怎么处理加密的 PII 特征？
q_en: How should the online serving path handle encrypted PII features?
why: 线上路径保持用 tokenized/masked（脱敏）特征，别实时解密——解密会加延迟、还扩大 PII 暴露面。解密只留给离线审计/客服等低频场景。模型本就不该看原始 PII。
why_en: Keep the serving path on tokenized/masked features and avoid live decryption, which adds latency and widens PII exposure; reserve decryption for offline audit/support.
tradeoff: 线上用脱敏特征（低延迟+小暴露面） vs 实时解密（拿原值但加延迟+扩大 PII 风险）
options: 线上实时解密取原始 PII，反正原值信息最全，模型精度最高
线上保持用脱敏/tokenized 特征，不实时解密；解密只留给离线审计/客服
线上线下都永久明文存 PII，省去加解密开销最省事
把 PII 特征直接删掉不用，任何脱敏都嫌麻烦
options_en: Decrypt PII live on the serving path — raw values carry the most info and maximize accuracy.
Keep serving on masked/tokenized features and don't decrypt live; reserve decryption for offline audit/support.
Store PII in plaintext everywhere online and offline to skip crypto overhead.
Just delete all PII features — any masking is too much hassle.
whenOtherWins: 只有离线的审计、调查或客服排障等低频、可控访问场景，才在严格权限下解密查看原始 PII。
whenOtherWins_en: Only low-frequency, controlled-access offline cases — audit, investigation, support — decrypt raw PII under strict permissions.
optionExplanations: 实时解密既加延迟又扩大 PII 暴露面，且模型多半用脱敏特征就够，追原值得不偿失。
对；线上走脱敏特征既守延迟预算又缩小暴露面，解密留给离线可控场景，风险最小。
全程明文违反最小化与安全存储原则，一旦泄露后果最重，是最差选项。
有用的 PII 派生特征可脱敏后安全使用，直接全删是把有效信号也一起丢了。
optionExplanations_en: Live decryption adds latency and widens PII exposure, and masked features usually suffice — chasing raw values isn't worth it.
Correct — serving on masked features keeps the latency budget and shrinks exposure; decryption stays in controlled offline cases, minimizing risk.
Plaintext throughout violates minimization and secure-storage principles and is worst on breach impact — the worst option.
Useful PII-derived features can be masked and used safely; deleting all of them throws away valid signal too.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把原始 PII 替换成不可逆 token/假名，模型看不到真值仍可用作特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tokenization/masking replaces raw PII with irreversible tokens/pseudonyms so the model never sees real values yet can still use them as features.
